annotations.title: Write a thread from an article or notes (AI)

description: Turn an article, blog post, notes, changelog or transcript into a ready-to-post thread (hook first, one point per post, wrap-up last) for X, Bluesky, Farcaster, Mastodon or Threads. An open model on Cloudflare Workers AI writes it; Thread Kit re-measures and re-splits every post so each one fits, removes links that are not in the source and flags numbers that are not in it. A failed generation is not charged. PAID: $0.010 per call in USDC on Base via x402 over MCP, or from prepaid credits if this server is configured with an Authorization: Bearer tkc_... header (see payment_options).

lang.description: Output language: auto = same as the source (default), or en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, es, fr, de, pt, ru, id, vi, tr, it

numbering.description: Where to put "n/N": suffix (default), prefix or none. Counted in each post's length.

platform.description: Target network: x (default), bluesky, farcaster, mastodon or meta-threads

posts.description: Number of posts, 3-12; omit to let the writer choose from the source length

text.description: Source to turn into a thread: article, notes or transcript (100-3000 characters)

name: write_thread_from_article
